description: Fill the selection on the active layer with a colour (Edit > Fill), with a blend mode, opacity and optionally preserving transparency

color.description: "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black), "hsb(h,s,b)" (0-360, 0-100, 0-100) or "lab(L,a,b)". Default the foreground colour
